_about: R29: a real K1C (firmware 1.3.5.22) from idle through a print started and cancelled during its start-of-print self-test (while homing), as the printer streamed it on 2026-10-05. One line per frame, in order; t is seconds since the first frame. Heartbeats dropped, the print history (historyList) removed, hostname anonymised; values otherwise as received, numbers-as-strings included.
